reviews.comment: Prof Pharr has some of the most digestible lectures I've ever had. He posts fill in the blank notes that he goes through thoroughly and encourages students to ask any type of questions. Attendance is only mandatory on his in class quiz and exam day. There is only one exam and he posts plenty of study material for it. Group projects were easy.

Genuinely a great class to take. He clearly loves teaching this material and he is very accommodating to students taking the course. The homework is participation and the in class quizzes are exactly like the homework. No tests except for the final and the rest is group project grades that are extremely doable if you're just a little competent.

One of the best lecturers I have ever had. He is very knowledgeable and passionate about the material. Class overall is interesting and has a light load, The HW is graded for completion and quizzes are similar to HW. Group project is not too much work if divided and the final is not too bad if you just memorize the review.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Cool guy who cares about his subject. He is very reasonable with graded work, and isn't out to hurt anyone's GPA. Makes the course very interesting and enriching.

Matt is awesome. He does a great job explaining material science even though some of the ideas may be hard to comprehend. Also plays alot of videos that help understand what's going on. Drops one-liners every class too. No mandatory attendance but fill in the blank notes. By far and away the best prof for 360. There's a reason his students love him
